name: components_family_mechanical
source:
// Domain family: MECHANICAL rotational (mechanical.frees). Across w, flow tau.
// 20 N.m through a 3:1 gear into a 0.5 N.m.s damper against ground.
TorqueSource     TQ(T = 20)
Gear             GR(ratio = 3)
RotationalDamper DP(c = 0.5)
MechGround       G1()
MechGround       G2()
connect(TQ.a, GR.in)
connect(TQ.b, G1.port)
connect(GR.out, DP.a)
connect(DP.b, G2.port)
w_in    = GR.in.w
w_out   = GR.out.w
tau_out = GR.out.tau

// Storage: an Inertia declares der(port.w). With no DYNAMIC block the network
// solves its steady operating point (der -> 0), so the inertia carries no
// torque and the damper takes all 5 N.m: w = 20 rad/s.
TorqueSource     TQ2(T = 5)
RotationalDamper DP2(c = 0.25)
Inertia          IN(J = 0.4, w0 = 0)
MechGround       G3()
MechGround       G4()
connect(TQ2.a, IN.port, DP2.a)
connect(TQ2.b, G3.port)
connect(DP2.b, G4.port)
w_steady = IN.port.w
